description: The last N lines of a log source

example: 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z INFO    [Global   ] Backend PID 1 listening on port 3000 ...

size.description: Size in bytes of the underlying log file

truncated.description: True when the file is larger than the maximum amount of data scanned per request
